idea: A food delivery app that delivers restaurant meals to homes in big Indian cities.
A ride-hailing app that connects passengers with taxi and auto-rickshaw drivers in Indian cities.
A general online marketplace where anyone can buy and sell new and used products across India.
A study-buddy app that matches college students in India into small groups for exam preparation, with a shared study planner and weekly mock quizzes.
A tool that helps small restaurants in India predict daily demand and reduce food waste using their past sales data.
A booking platform that lets coworking spaces rent out empty meeting rooms by the hour to freelancers, with an approval workflow.
A marketplace for renting camping gear in rural Bhutan.
A platform that makes life easier for everyone.
